## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57]

The report rates EPAC Neutral/Wait with low confidence at IDR 50. All OHLC values equal 50 and five-day realized volatility is zero, which it treats as inactivity rather than safe execution. Trend/EMA/Fisher evidence is bearish, while oversold short RSI/stochastic/Donchian offers unconfirmed rebound potential. Volume Ratio 20D 0.001603 and severe volume contraction are decisive liquidity concerns; exact feature scaling and volume units remain uncertain.[^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57]

Session-10 scenarios are bull IDR 52–54 at 20%, base IDR 49–51 at 45%, and bear IDR 41–48 at 35%. The representative gross expected return is −2.3%. Lower-price tradability and tick constraints are not established, so modeled analytical ranges must not be presented as executable orders.[^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57]

The report attributes a proposed up-to-10% buyback using up to IDR 20 billion and a November 3 RUPSLB to September 25 news. Approval and implementation are outside the forecast window. Its 15% sales-growth objective coexists with reported first-half loss and oil/freight cost pressure. Digital-printing expansion and possible rights issuance create capital-allocation tension with the buyback. Control-change context is explicitly a secondary AI-generated synopsis.[^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57]

Confirmation is a completed close above about IDR 52.23 with material volume recovery; stronger confirmation is 54.46. The 41.41 indicator-derived boundary is analytical and the executable stop is unavailable. Profit zone is 52–54; reconstructed 20-day high 61 is a lower-probability reference rather than assured target. Illustrative 53/41.41/61 economics are only 0.69:1 gross.[^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57]

The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to rupiah stabilization, with imported film/resin/machinery cost exposure conditional on hedging and pricing power. It attributes a September 16 Fed increase to dollar, capital-flow and financing pressure for a loss-making small manufacturer.[^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57]
